notes.title: 1.2.1 Patchnotes
notes.content:
[b]New Crews Join Golden Record Retriever![/b]

New crews have arrived! Strengthen your strategy and try out diverse playstyles.

[b]Wheat Flour Kev[/b]  
A reliable ally who can play the role of a powerful joker. However, he is vulnerable to injuries, making his stamina low.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43311458/39ba926db85d9c0974f5087f8d475c5a052540f3.png[/img]
[b]Stinky Kunk[/b]  
Kunk can reliably generate three-colored auras, but their placement is unpredictable.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43311458/2ef87474dcea899df31e7ef1639435026e508456.png[/img]
[b]Whispery Momo[/b]  
Momo doesn’t create many auras, but she provides them exactly where they are needed.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43311458/957cb75fbd9b68efa5e18e78cdef4ef5c3e01b50.png[/img]
[b]Photographer Billie[/b]  
Billie can recreate auras that were successfully made in previous attempts. The ability to generate heavy auras can be both an advantage and a disadvantage.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43311458/1839457dc6bccad959f9bb2a68c18fce672227bc.png[/img]
[b]Cheer Captain Charlie[/b]  
Charlie grants a powerful buff to all Vocalons. He is a great choice for forming a unique and loud team.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43311458/a54fbf355494b4574e3b1edcb768b8173d32712b.png[/img]

notes.title: 1.1.0 Patchnotes + New Languages!
notes.content:
Hello, Retrievers! We brought you a new patch note!

It includes the addition of a new companion and support for Chinese, Japanese, and German.

[h2]New Teammates[/h2]

[h3]“Weird Eater“ Blob[/h3]

Blob is a teammate that produces a lot of auras. Like other teammates who scatter large amounts of auras randomly, Blob has the advantage of being able to decide the next move by observing the generation of auras when scattering auras at the beginning of the next turn.

Another significant advantage of Blob is its ability to easily remove gray auras. This shines especially in situations where you need to produce a lot of auras by removing heavy gray auras that interfere with aura production and converting them into available auras.

[h3]“Abandoned” Poly
[/h3]
Polly, a three-head dog abandoned by its onwer, is an attractive teammate with the ability to return when entering. By continuing to utilize entry despite the restriction that you cannot re-enter the same tile once entered, it is possible to employ extreme strategies such as entering 8 times on the first try.

Various creative usage methods can be devised when combined with antiques or gear items such as Peace Player that always treats entry as “Dash”.

[h2]Added Languages[/h2]

Chinese(Simplified Characters), Japanese, and German, which have been frequently requested, have been added. Now users of these languages can conveniently enjoy GRR!

notes.title: 0.10.3 Patchnotes
notes.content:
Hello, Retrievers! Today, we're back with a new friend you can encounter in space.

[h2]Delgo[/h2]
Delgo is a space Cerberus, serving as the inspiration for the popular character Captain Bangrock.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43311458/d429c92304e651387e6a9c0e0be21a9f629f8380.gif[/img]

Roaming through space, Delgo offers gifts through simple games in exchange for Dori whenever it encounters a spaceship. Test your dynamic vision and luck!


[h2]Bug fixes[/h2]

🐛 The issue of missing Gestor race icons in the text has been corrected.
🐛 Several text errors have been fixed.

notes.title: 0.10.2 Patchnotes
notes.content:
Hello, Retrievers! We're excited to bring you the 0.10.2 patch notes.

This patch welcomes three new teammates to the crew!

[h2]New Teammates[/h2]
[h3]Storyteller Soap[/h3]

Storyteller Soap may be an ordinary Bocolun, but with a supply of grey auras, he can become a jack-of-all-trades. His ability to play a powerful role in teams centered around grey auras is a fantastic advantage. Additionally, his capability to easily eliminate grey resources in missions that hinder progress makes him a viable option even for teams that don't produce grey auras. Upgrades that further enhance this utility are also available.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43311458/3abfee9b4df0072718be39da78da595cb21b174d.png[/img]

[h3]Herbalist Wood[/h3]

Herbalist Wood is the second Gestor to directly heal teammates, following Kross. Unlike Kross, who heals precisely one teammate or multiple teammates in an area, Wood heals teammates who have yet to enter, ensuring key teammates can avoid risks.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43311458/a37b5e3230bf165adc9db27719c18893746df89b.png[/img]

[h3]Peace Girl Laura[/h3]

Like many Odras with their powerful effects, Peace Girl Laura also has a potent yet demanding ability. If any aura can be created on Lora's square by any means, Laura distributes the same aura across all surrounding cells. This effect applies not only with the help of other teammates but also with pellets and action cards effects.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43311458/7ba8db609306809c30e794555515489ab773b72a.png[/img]

notes.title: 0.10.1 Patch Notes
notes.content:
Hello, Retrievers. We're bringing you the 0.10.1 patch notes today.

This patch introduces 3 new teammates and 3 new ship upgrades.

[h2]New Teammates[/h2]

[h3]Entomologist Dora[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43311458/3d4b67a233106858c5025a138810d886b63124f4.png[/img]

Dora is a teammate who connects two boxes on the board each try, providing the same aura in one box to the other, effectively scratching those hard-to-reach places. Especially since resources produced through equipment are also supplied through these pathways, having the right gear can double its effects, which is a significant advantage.

[h3]Headbutt Rock[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43311458/7186f14dcb2d590af0c4cbe9fa898bfd2ff0753e.png[/img]

If you need a teammate who gets the job done, Rock is your go-to. With a reliably activating ability, Rock helps players solidify their strategy. Through upgrades, his stability can be further enhanced, and he can be energized to push through longer missions.

[h3]Leech Chu[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43311458/092f68dc637c769cd1d4d6b951d0faa718542398.png[/img]

Belonging to a parasitic alien species, Chu sticks to the most recently recruited teammate, mimicking their actions when they re-roll or return. Chu's utility varies significantly depending on the host, showing extraordinary effects with teammates who frequently return or re-roll.

[h2]Additional Ship Upgrades[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43311458/b693138d61480c9c12986138ad69b69239ad1af4.png[/img]

Three types of ship upgrades have been added. The most significant change allows for the upgrading of the Arbetti.

[h2]Bug Fixes[/h2]

🐛 Fixed an issue where the random seed value might not apply correctly during the teammate selection process.

🐛 Corrected a problem where the UI for checking non-recruitable candidates might not appear in certain situations.

🐛 Fixed an issue where clearing with a passionate fan in the destination planet "Beatenbiv" might not process correctly.

🐛 Corrected abnormal dialogue progression when proceeding with a passionate fan in the destination planet "Beatenbiv."

🐛 Fixed a display issue for some paths in the path selection view.

🐛 Corrected layout errors in the UI displaying special conditions during scouting events.

🐛 Fixed an abnormal display of selectable options UI after one selection during scouting events.

🐛 Corrected an issue where the story event related to "Rusty" might not progress correctly.

🐛 Fixed a problem where pausing through the options menu could be undone after accessing the logbook during gameplay.

🐛 Corrected an issue where the options menu couldn't be accessed with the Esc key during dialogue progression or dice actions.

[h2]Improvements[/h2]

✨ Faction(Tokens, actors)-related text within action cards now includes faction icons.

✨ Improved display for non-teammate dice injury indicators.

✨ Enhanced the arrow UI display method when selecting dice and pellets.

notes.title: 0.9.11 Patchnotes
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43311458/f34b0647a4569b1173613317b6af1963a8208c93.gif[/img]


Hello, Retrievers! Today, we're back with teammates who will help you make more use of the grey auras.

[h2]Wood Nymph Ivy[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43311458/c43a08e409c59d22ef7acc0306360c8844b49bc8.png[/img]

Ivy turns nearby auras into Ruse. Even if there's no gray auras, you won't suffer a significant loss, which is why she's the first teammate we're introducing.

Ivy can be a valuable addition even in teams that don't produce a lot of gray auras. If more teammates who produce gray auras join later, upgrading Ivy can increase her expected value. Or, you can just upgrades her sides and up her low points, giving flexibility in team composition.

[h2]Sharper Rick[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43311458/9e6a171c1d79a4af0a6c8325bbb30ffb22b94f7c.png[/img]

Sharper Rick is excellent at filling counts while simultaneously producing both Wisdom and Ruse. However, he also produces a lot of gray auras, which can lead to moments where auras fill up the board. With upgrades, Rick can be transformed into a teammate who always fills counts by 3 or significantly increases the value of the auras he produces.

Being with teammates who can well utilize gray auras, Rick's powerful aura production abilities can be even more useful.

[h2]Heavy Smoker Greg[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43311458/4a51619b5d442d16289dfecc1c6688a12e8f2bd9.png[/img]

Lastly, Greg can clear gray auras and return all teammates whose box had the gray auras.

Like other Odras, Greg also requires certain conditions to unleash his full power. To maximize his potential, it’s essential to have teammates, gear, and antiques that produce gray auras.

[h2]Bug Fixes[/h2]

🐛 Fixed an issue where the enemy dice "Lafafi III" from Pydamir would only activate once per turn.

🐛 Fixed an issue where Clover's "2 Fools" had a range limited only around Clover.

🐛 Corrected an issue where the UI indicating teammates no longer recruitable was unnecessarily active.

[h2]Improvements[/h2]

✨ Improved Puko's ability & sides upgrades.

✨ Improved the UI for selecting dice sides.

notes.title: 0.9.10 Patchnotes + Achievements!
notes.content:
Hello, Retrievers!

This patch includes new challenges and some mission modifications, as well as introducing new teammates.

[h2]Achievements[/h2]

You can now unlock Achievements on Steam, and any achievements you earned so far will be retroactively applied. Initially, 16 challenges have been added, and 4 more will be available upon official release.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43311458/a0ee8e6e502bf65e3e90f11b801f702b6bb31c59.png[/img]
 
[h2]New Teammate[/h2]

[h3]Fisherman Guy[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43311458/aa0e42129a90db38df239519bf7963176455aa1f.png[/img]

Guy is a Gagalga, which was mentioned as a Gustati tribe in the description of gear "Gagalga Liquor Set (Tumbler)", and he's a sturdy one responsible for toughness. While Guy can handle toughness on his own in typical situations, his ability to clear other auras into toughness shines more in situations with abundant gray auras or when other teammates overproduce auras.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43311458/9e32ce008995706c35587ba4c4a7242acd70017a.gif[/img]

Upgrades can increase the proportion of producing heavy auras, providing more stable toughness, and if ventilation is actively needed, expanding the area of ventilation to nearby spaces can turn him into the team's cleaner.

[h3]Jerome[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43311458/32e4ea8339d24f03acbc857a13c6d22229dc0b6c.png[/img] 

Jerome, like many other Vocolens, can evenly draw Wisdom, Grit, and Ruse. However, unlike others, he enables players to place auras where they want after a side rolls out. This non-entry effect means multiple teammates can produce auras if re-rolls are possible. Since the next teammate produces auras, it also benefits from special effects of teammates like Kirst who produce auras.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43311458/c51014e4aaea9be8c771c87df473660923221578.gif[/img]

His weakness is that he can't provide auras on his own, requiring help from others to function, and he doesn't pair well with teammates who produce a lot of auras.

[h2]Bug Fixes[/h2]

🐛 Fixed issue where the game could freeze when certain teammates (such as Sally, Devon, etc.) were present during a situation restart.
🐛 Fixed the antique 'Rusty Spray' where it would scatter the auras instead of providing them.
🐛 Fixed issue where chains of action cards wouldn't disappear even after one of the chained cards was deleted.
🐛 Fixed issue where a prioritized card would not hide the others.

[h2]Improvements[/h2]

✨ In recruiting situations, the cadet list on the left AOD will now show which teammate is no longer recruitable.
✨ Added a delay to the end of a situation upon failure.
✨ Added a delay to the restart of a situation.
✨ Improved the text layout inside action cards.

notes.title: 0.9.9 Patchnotes + New Teammates!
notes.content:
Hello, Retriever! Today, we're excited to share some updates with you, including the introduction of new teammates that many of you have been eagerly awaiting.

[h3]New Face Milla[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43311458/e887a08e7a8a70c68005cb1ee1acc0eee569dfd7.png[/img]

Our first new face is Milla. She specializes in generating a lot of auras if her mood is right (which isn't too hard to achieve!). Her re-rolling effect is suitable for using various equipment. However, her weakness lies in filling up spaces too quickly, making it difficult to recover if she doesn't produce the desired aura.

[h3]Homeboy Beber[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43311458/2501d7d416c316ce55744953bc4416d9e364d2a1.png[/img]

Homeboy Beber is a tactician with strong defenses in various situations where auras are ventilated. Thanks to his ability to return ventilated resources, he prevents the loss of momentum in scenarios that require continuous attacks, like with Beatenbiv and Takeabyte. He can also be utilized with teammates like Pike or Jules who ventilate resources.

[h3]Explorer Marge[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43311458/810ee780f9d962bf182d2b0f39c32eec02bdf459.png[/img]

Marge may not precisely produce auras, but she offers versatile effects by providing auras at both ends of a thrown dice. This allows her to give a second chance to an already thrown dice or pre-emptively supply auras before another dice is thrown. Upgrading her can enhance precision or increase resource production, making her adaptable to various destinations.

[h3]Sausage Hand Tommy[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43311458/085a5f3d5af8c17e8f3afb6857649c0a107cd1e2.png[/img]

Tommy, one of the more demanding Gestors, doesn't move until other teammates have set the stage, but once he does, he lives up to expectations. His role can change significantly with upgrades, either matching tempo in high-value teams or compensating for the lack of value in more intricate combinations.

[h3]Plumber Jam[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43311458/870112aee10759bc0a69c5eb9d26afaa2a5960dd.png[/img]

Jam, like other Odras, has a powerful effect – maintaining auras between attempts. If used actively, this can make even the toughest action cards easy to achieve. However, it can also lead to missed opportunities and lessened advantages if not enough precision is employed.

[h3]Sleepyhead Pillo[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43311458/9a0e7e412d08cd65ebcf3647f314caff6e168af2.png[/img]

Pillo is a high-value teammate who forgoes stability and initial effects for significant returns. Strategic use is required as it's difficult to adjust his position after the first attempt, but he offers a substantial amount of aura without many requirements.

And...

[h3]Icy Judge Hart[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43311458/11efdefe5aba0171296916dd626bdbc162e6a41c.png[/img]

With the removal of the Formula, Ice Judge Hart temporarily left us but has now rejoined with new effects. Still easily swayed by other teammates, Hart produces resources by waveringly reacting to teammates entering the queue.

[h2]Changes[/h2]

✨ When releasing a teammate equipped with gear, the loss of that gear is now indicated in the summary window.
✨ Clicking on lost gear or antiques in the summary window links to the Log Book.
✨ Clicking on the upgrade UI on the back of a teammate card links to the Log Book.
✨ When acquiring Dori, it briefly appears on the radio and can be toggled between Dori and Grass by clicking the icon.
✨ Mouse hover over action cards now displays related tooltips (previously only in the tutorial, now extended to the entire game).
✨ The first mission in Beatenbiv now provides additional grey resources for a smoother play experience.
✨ Fixed an issue where players could enter the last mission in 'Pydamir' without the missing (intruder) dice.

[h2]Bug Fixes[/h2]

🐛 Fixed an issue where teammates equipped with 'Gambel by Areph' could be released.
🐛 Corrected the display of 'Gambel by Areph' as a curse attribute in the equipment view.
🐛 Fixed an issue where resources altered by the 'Cursed Box' karma weren't reflected in shape action cards.
🐛 Corrected an issue where Velvet's ability could remove the Lafafi die.

notes.title: 0.9.5 Antiques!
notes.content:
Hello, Retrievers!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43311458/0578c66e82e520eca3c0eb318a126cb92c0708fd.png[/img]

Today, we bid farewell to the Formula system and introduce the new system: Antiques.

[h2]Formula[/h2]

Formula was a concept born out of necessity. Since gear was dependent on teammates, there was a need for a component independent of teammates. Initially, the Formula had the following roles:

A deck-building component not dependent on teammates
A role in adjusting probabilities (The reason Gestor was continuously linked with Formula was due to sharing this characteristic)
A solution for unanticipated crises (injuries, grey resources, etc.) without using teammate slots
As the concept evolved, Formula began to fulfill additional roles:

Rewards in various scouting and event scenarios
Feedback for specific playstyles (like completing a mission with four people using a secret weapon)
However, due to design issues, after several changes, we determined that Formula was no longer contributing positively to the game experience.

Given the dice-building nature of the system, the card-formula was always meant to be ancillary. Its effects and mechanisms were intended to adjust probabilities, not directly solve problems. For example, the original basic Formula, which scattered a resource when two teammates entered, was meant to be used for assessment and decision-making before fully engaging in an attempt.

However, the requirement of fulfilling a quest to use it and the card consumption mechanism led players to have higher expectations of the Formula's utility. This mismatch led to feedback on Formula's underperformance, which was followed by a patch significantly enhancing the utility of the basic Formula.

This change led to Formulas becoming as effective as teammates, making them too important in solving quests. The situation where the secondary overtook the primary led to increased fatigue from overusing Formulas, and other Formulas besides the basic ones became relatively underused due to their lack of effectiveness. At this point, we decided to add a new system to replace Formulas, focusing on the following constraints and objectives:

No direct interaction required by the player
Designed to influence playstyle without concentrating decision-making at one point
Supports a focus on dice rather than detracting from it

After much deliberation, we came up with the Antiques system.

[h2]Antiques[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43311458/61200205f7eef65dcd4744920d639a5b2df129a7.gif[/img]

Antiques are passive elements that assist in resolving situations. Divided into three rarity tiers, Antiques provide subtle assistance in tier 1, interact with the team and influence decision-making in tier 2, and have a significant but hard-to-find impact in tier 3.

The method of acquiring Antiques remains similar to Formulas, either by completing missions with a certain probability or as additional rewards from scouting, landmarks, and specific missions.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43311458/20213d4889dfd4600a12061b47fcae2447bf04bb.gif[/img]

You can hold up to three Antiques, viewable in the teammate management view and on the board. There are currently about 50 different Antiques in the game. We hope the introduction of Antiques will provide a more enjoyable and comfortable experience.

Changes
✨ Gear Attribute - 'Destroyed After Mission' has been removed, and the method of choosing the first teammate for a new run has been changed to selecting Antiques.

Bug Fixes
🐛 An error in the initiation judgment when using 'Pocket Arbetti' has been corrected.

🐛 'Bouncy Foot' activating on all entries, not just rushes, has been fixed.

🐛 'Cassie' changing or adding 'Persons of Interest' upon resume has been corrected.

notes.title: 0.9.4 Patchnotes with new Karma system!
notes.content:
Hello, this is Hoochoo Game Studios, and today we're here with a new system update.

[h2]🆕 Karma System[/h2]

Each planet where you need to recover Golden Records is unique and full of character. Any good retriever would always consider forming a team that can handle this diversity. However, we realized that the unique themes of each target planet were not sufficiently influencing the journey to recover the Golden Records. This led us to question whether there was enough incentive and reward for making such strategic choices. To address this and enhance the game's replayability, we have introduced a system called Karma.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43311458/680f113992f1aeb223171c08a2b190153e66fa12.gif[/img]

Now, whenever you collect a Golden Record from a target planet, the enraged local residents will start to interfere with the protagonist and their team in their own unique ways. This will apply the next time you undertake a mission to that planet.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43311458/344e7ddac89eeb1ffc5936703317d60ed3b9a27f.gif[/img]

[h2]G-Star Participation[/h2]

✨ Golden Record Retriever will be participating in this year's G-Star held at BEXCO, Busan! The event is scheduled to run from November 16th to 20th, and we have a Twitter event planned for ticket giveaways, so stay tuned!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43311458/b6809034a9a284c51d35985519e6c426da603608.jpg[/img]

[h2]Updates[/h2]

✨ Upgrads are added to teammate “Nimar”

✨ Upgrade 1 of teammate “Burpee” was changed (Buffed)

[h2]Bug Fixes[/h2]

🐛 The arrow direction on the 'Guard Ruinite ‘' enemy dice was reversed, and the image has been updated.

🐛 Teammate 'Calore' was sometimes providing resources to teammates who already had them; this issue has been fixed.

🐛 Text stacks in the Global Effect UI were not displayed properly, and this has been corrected.

🐛 The shop UI allowed purchases before the animation was complete; this has been fixed.

🐛 The 'Remove All Pellets' action was not functioning correctly and has been fixed.

🐛 In the Corrupted Shop, equipment could appear multiple times; this issue has been resolved.

notes.content:
🆕 Rubet’s shops Corrupted by the Home Seekers

Those Rubet’s shops in planets taken by the Home Seekers now offer special gear.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43311458/3aa2e7b2128a900d79720952dfc69dfc60db6747.gif[/img]

Hello Retrievers! As promised, a major patch is now ready. For an overview of the patch, please refer to our previous post.

https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/2119580/view/3663169778002214902?l=english

[h1]Tutorial Renewal[/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43311458/d5d64bdfe00dce98a32aa241a9d6e6d35c43b7f1.gif[/img]

We have created an entirely new tutorial. The previous tutorial focused on teaching controls but failed to set proper expectations for the experience players would have while retrieving Golden Records. The new tutorial aims to provide more insights into what players will actually encounter in the gaming space.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43311458/e755c51d8f4fce4c5701dff125c97b0b110954a6.gif[/img]

[h1]Teammates 2.0[/h1]

We’ve made significant changes to the Teammate system, and many Teammates have undergone reworks. Now, Teammates start off in a more “primitive” state and evolve as they continue to adventure with the player. We aimed to keep the initial versions of early-game Teammates as simple as possible to make the learning curve more gentle.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43311458/574c8b1e890289abc6b282702b0492c46331980b.gif[/img]

Players can now collect keys from Ender Quests of each situation to upgrade their Teammates. While most upgrades will generally strengthen a Teammate’s abilities, some may require you to take higher risks or utilize the Teammate in different ways, adding a layer of strategy.

Since we're trying to make quick improvements to a system we initially designed, we know there’s much to fix. Your feedback would be highly appreciated.

[h2]Basic Formula Improvements[/h2]

We have removed the randomness in basic formulas and now provide an aura to the position where the next teammate will be thrown. This should lead to more consistent gameplay.

We’ve made general improvements to the cabin graphics.

notes.title: Massive update Announcement
notes.content:
Hello Retrievers!

Since launching our early access game, we've received valuable feedback from many of you. The majority of comments have been about the game's learning curve and the luck-dependent gameplay. After much consideration, we've decided to roll out a major update.

The key directions of the update are as follows:

[b]1. Transitioning from a Card Game to a Dice Game[/b]
    
    Golden Record Retriever is a roguelike deck-building game. However, the randomness introduced by dice makes it hard for players to anticipate how their built decks will work, especially for newcomers. So, we're planning to start with uniform dice (where all sides are the same) and gradually introduce more "dice-like" effects.
    
[b]2. Enabling Players to Choose Their Odds[/b]
    
    Golden Record Retriever offers various ways to deal with probability. The core enjoyment comes from experimenting with different approaches based on deck-building strategies and personal preferences. To make the game more accessible, we'll modify the design to allow players greater control over the randomness of their dice. Ultimately, we hope to retain the original theme of dealing with luck and probability while allowing players to control these aspects at their own pace.
    

[h2]Specific Patch Directions[/h2]

[h3]1. Removing the Incubator Tutorial and Starting from the Ship[/h3]
    
    We originally wanted to offer a basic tutorial in a minimalistic space to reduce UI complexity. However, we realized that this sterile, empty space lacks motivation. We aim to introduce fun elements earlier in the game.
    
[h3]2. Teammate System Revamp[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43311458/30783efe4d106605076f8cf46e1ffb7117d267db.png[/img]
    For example, Rod will now have simpler abilities and a more consistent die when recruited. However, he can be upgraded during the game to either give up some stability for more intricate abilities or to completely forsake stability for potent value-creating abilities. The rework aims to make the early game more straightforward and mitigate steep learning curves.
    This is expected to add depth to dice-building not only for newcomers but also for experienced players

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43311458/d2c67d95009b5cd13bedb88468e25e3aa0940b0f.png[/img]
    Even for teammates who appear later in the game, like Mei, the basic form may remain the same. However, upgrades will allow for greater versatility in how they fit into different teams.
    

[h2]Roadmap Changes[/h2]

Given the significant game alterations, changes to our roadmap are inevitable. We've reviewed the development schedule while trying to maintain the existing roadmap, especially in terms of user convenience.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43311458/25b9beaa395cd122a02ed63392699ca225e36b36.png[/img]

Thank you for your support!

notes.title: Teammate Highlight #2 Scar
notes.content:
Hello Retrievers! Welcome to the second teammate highlight! Honestly, we wanted to introduce a new teammate this week, but due to our all-mighty artist's vacation, we'll be introducing an existing teammate once more! We'll be back with a new teammate next week!

[h1]Ingrown Scar[/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43311458/6f62516e6dd1aad52fe75c69ff3252338e51b41e.png[/img]

The second star of our teammate highlight is Ingrown Scar! The fearful Tectoro Ska may be easily frightened by small things, but he soon stands strong as a fierce warrior, fist clenched.

Scar will eventually draw Grit. Alongside Green, who somehow draws Cunning, and Devon, who draws Wisdom across two spaces, Ingrown Scar is a teammate in Golden Record Retriever who definitively produces specific resources. However, only Ingrown Scar knows when that will be, which can be a constraint in situations where there's a penalty attached to the entry itself.

[h2]How to Use[/h2]

Ingrown Scar is an excellent source of Wisdom and is responsible for guaranteed Grit. He can fulfill many roles in various teams, but the best way to utilize Ingrown Scar is to leverage his re-entry ability. While there are many constraints to entering, the power to enter multiple times and utilize items with entry effects several times is a significant advantage. Extremely, providing Vivi with a dash gear and Ingrown Scar with Tata enables such power plays.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43311458/eb303ac8a0f7c673e64a8ec822a4e619387a16cb.gif[/img]

Similarly, if you use the key reward Designated Bodyguard Selector with powerful entry abilities, you can utilize one attempt as if it were multiple attempts.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43311458/33b8330ff8a76c63f483ca31f7ffa5641a83cc23.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43311458/eb303ac8a0f7c673e64a8ec822a4e619387a16cb.gif[/img]

[h2]Weaknesses[/h2]

Ingrown Scar may be a jack-of-all-trades, but if you absolutely must draw Wisdom, he might let you down. While it may always seem like Ingrown Scar will return, there are many cases where he doesn't. If you focus all your strategies on Ingrown Scar's return, it often fails. To compensate, it's good to carry JackJack, Three or Rod, which have re-roll effects.

notes.title: Teammate Highlight #1 Rod
notes.content:
Hello Retriever folks! During the Early Access period, we plan to create a space to introduce a Teammate you can recruit every week. We'll explore how to utilize existing Teammates bi-weekly, and in the remaining weeks, we'll introduce new Teammates!

[h2]Gasoline Rod[/h2]

The first protagonist of Teammate Highlight is "Rod," the first Teammate that the player meets while playing the game! The self-made businessman Rod spreads the power of passion throughout the universe based on his success story. Even in the team, he takes on the role of igniting the passion of team members!

Rod has a powerful effect of[u][b] re-rolling the Buddy.[/b] [/u]It's not merely re-rolling; it has a very Gestor-like ability to re-roll [u][b]without the same side coming up[/b][/u] again.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43311458/0a91ae0974b55fb4c6b3f2d5e503d31f2b9e4904.png[/img]

[h3]Usage[/h3]

Rod's most basic usage is exploiting the fact that the same side won't come up again. Especially if there are only two sides, you can undoubtedly get the side you want, so you can use it to solve even challenging missions. There's good synergy with Teammates like Scar and Wally, who need to show a specific side.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43311458/78e9a7743bb2e5181427f438991eff4efdcc84a4.gif[/img]

Re-rolling itself doubles the effect of other Teammates, so it can have good synergy with Teammates that generate a lot of resources. In the case of Teammates who create many resources in one space, there might be waste, but with a broad range of providing aura like Stella or Fog, you can utilize Rod's effect without waste.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43311458/09ef146632df81563c898a987bfd17e3e7b1df57.gif[/img]

[h3]Weaknesses
[/h3]
If there is a weakness to Rod, it's that the box to re-roll the desired Teammate is fixed. Additionally, with a 4:2 die, its self-stability is somewhat lacking, so the more challenging the quest you need to solve, the more ambiguous moments you will encounter.

To overcome these weaknesses, you can either sprinkle aura to reduce Rod's generation burden or use equipment like Broken Tata that can additionally draw specific aura to fill Rod's position.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43311458/79eda52bc74c14a91ee526001988ce01b45351dc.png[/img]

notes.title: Golden Record Retriever Devlog #1
notes.content:
Hello, I am Seoha from Hoochoo Game Studios, who developed "No Umbrellas Allowed". I am writing to introduce our second game, "Golden Record Retriever". It has been about 10 months since we started this project, and now we are ready to show the game in bits and pieces, so I am trying to write a devlog.

[h1]Golden Record Retriever[/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43311458/12eaa5a205c4595972e89ec568fcdd2c43393004.png[/img]

In "Golden Record Retriever (GRR)", the protagonist is a golden retriever named "River". The story begins when a wealthy person who wanted to meet an alien sent thousands of records containing a heartfelt message to space. However, instead of introducing Earth to the aliens, these records caused trouble and disputes. The aliens became angry and came to Earth, but the wealthy person had already died, leaving only River behind. In order to smooth things over, the aliens decide to take River into space on a retrieval mission.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43311458/d5bcd7be4684c795193907364f0d5053a1d3ce23.png[/img]

"Golden Record Retriever (GRR)" is a roguelike dice-building game. The player must combine various dice (aliens!) with different abilities to solve problems. The protagonist, who must retrieve the golden records, must form a new team and travel through space each time.

In the captain's quarters, the player must solve the situation only with orders to their companions through a radio. This is similar to the way in which traditional text games present a situation and give a choice of options. However, instead of directly choosing their own path, the player must solve a puzzle through their companions. Therefore, depending on the team's personality and the way they solve problems, each choice may seem very easy or almost impossible.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43311458/71cc11a15c0039281499a52b019fac3dcaf481ce.gif[/img]

Story is an important element in both "No Umbrellas Allowed" and "Golden Record Retriever (GRR)". While "GRR" is a game that can be played infinitely, unlike traditional roguelike games, it has continuity in space by reconfiguring the journey through a map of 600 stars rather than resetting the map. Each planet will remember the events that took place on that planet, and you will be able to experience the changes on subsequent visits.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43311458/688327d1ab4df0fc6b133c419c0cd8c5ecaab82d.gif[/img]

[h1]Roadmap[/h1]

"Hoochoo Game Studios" is planning to release "Golden Record Retriever (GRR)" in the first half of next year. In preparation for the release, we are also preparing to release a demo on Steam as soon as possible, just like we did with our previous game, "No Umbrellas Allowed". We are also preparing for a Steam Playtest, so we welcome your interest.

We also plan to regularly write development logs. For the time being, we will talk about the process of making the game over the past 10 months rather than the current development status. In this context, we are considering the next topic to be either the setting and design of our central characters, the companions, or the story of how we overhauled the tutorial three times. If you have any questions, please leave them in the comments and we will actively consider them!
